done_when: core/hash.ts (the fingerprint/digest module) and shell/fs-atomic.ts golden-fixture unit tests are 100% green (no conformance filter yet — no CLI surface exists); unit-loop wall-clock time is measured and reported.
parseArgv, top-level flag redirects, formatHelp/formatCommandHelp, and version/help exit codes all match the old build byte-for-byte.

core/capability-table.ts (the Capability row data shape + lookup helpers) and the two generic interpreters (cli/dispatch.ts, mcp/dispatch.ts) exist and are wired for only a handful of capabilities (version/help/list). formatHelp/formatCommandHelp become pure projections of the table. A CLI `--help` walk and an MCP `tools/list` round-trip read the SAME table rows. This proves the one-source claim BEFORE any real capability exists; every milestone from here on adds capabilities as table rows only — dispatch.ts is never touched again. Moved here (was a late milestone 7 in the prior pass) specifically so the hand-sync risk this design exists to remove never opens up during the build itself; see v2/PLAN.md Revision note.

run-state schema, migration ladder, StateNode lifecycle/transition matrix, and node snapshot/diff/replay are byte-identical to the old build. Any CLI-facing state verb lands as a registry row, not a hand-written handler.

state-explosion summaries (collapse rules, thresholds, digests) and the contract-migration prover match the old build; new cases authored here if the existing state-* filter set is too thin to exercise them.

the 7-driver registry, local/shell/container/remote/ci drivers, agent spawn+parse+redact path, and sandbox profile checks match the old build. scripts/agents/* and scripts/children/* are copied byte-identical, not rewritten.
plan->dispatch->result->verify->commit spine, the default contract, and the commit gate's ~25 error codes match the old build; dispatch/commit-specific cases authored here if coverage is thin.

drive(), sub-workflow fulfillment, loop() expansion, and the incremental result cache match the old build; drive-specific cases authored here. core/pipeline/drive-decide.ts stays a pure decision function with zero process spawns in its own unit tests.

ledger propose/review/verify/apply/list, the telemetry attestation ledger, the trust-audit hash chain, and the tamper/bundle demos match the old build; ledger/telemetry/audit-specific cases authored here.

multi-agent runtime records, the three built-in topologies, coordinator/blackboard, candidate scoring, collaboration, and the eval/replay harness match the old build; multi-agent-specific conformance cases are authored from scratch here (none exist yet).
the wall-clock scheduler, routine triggers, run registry/queue, control-plane scheduling, gc/reclamation, orphans, and clones match the old build.

report.md rendering, cw doctor/fix, run export/import/restore, the offline report bundle, metrics, and the read-only Workbench match the old build; report/doctor/workbench-specific cases authored here.
workflow-app manifest load/validate/init/package/run match the old build; app-lifecycle conformance cases authored here.

every remaining capability (candidate/audit/collaboration/workbench/feedback-view rows) is filled into the registry from milestone 2 as pure additive data — no dispatch code changes at this step, by construction. The live payload-identical probe confirms --json bytes equal MCP tools/call bytes for every capability marked payloadIdentical. node v2/conformance/run.js --bin <v2 build> with no --filter is 100% green, and every case touched during authoring is re-confirmed green against the old build.
